executive_summary:
The host opens with Dana Loesch, whom she says posted more than 23 times on X after claiming she did not care that people mocked her "widow" scripture speech at the Young Women's Leadership Summit (A-2628.1). The host says her sources told her that Erika Kirk cut her own speech short after an attendee called her a "pedophile protector" and then left the summit without closing it out. She plays a Dana Loesch audio clip saying Erika "wasn't there for the whole weekend" (A-2628.2). The host contrasts this with Charlie Kirk's habit of facing hecklers (A-2629.1). She alleges that Erika invented a Secret Service threat to avoid an event with JD Vance, that Erika partners with people such as Greg Laurie who are accused of trafficking, and that Erika personally phoned clergy and attendees to discourage them from attending the host's Catholics for Catholics event in March. She also alleges that Erika directed Andrew Kolvet's statement that Charlie only liked Catholic architecture.

The host then reads two follow-up emails (A-2630.1, A-2630.2) that she sent to Justin Streiff, Andrew Kolvet and the TPUSA lawyer. The emails ask for an on-record yes or no on whether the WLS video in which Charlie Kirk appears to appoint Erika to run Turning Point USA is authentic. She says the only reply was a TPUSA X account post sharing her email (A-2630.3). She names the donors who asked the question as Julie and Arthur Fields of North Carolina, saying this removes TPUSA's stated reason for withholding the full video. According to the host, a donor source says the video is doctored, and Charlie told the donors at a later dinner only that the board would figure out succession. On the "emotional asset" email, the host says the NSA redirected her FOIA request to the Department of War (A-2631.1). She says the Department of War called the request too burdensome (A-2631.2), and that her office then narrowed it to named recipients including Bradley Hansell, Richard Smale, Gustav Anderly and Michaela Mott (A-2631.3).

In the second segment the host plays Ivanka Trump on David Senra's podcast saying she and Jared Kushner found a 1,400-hectare Mediterranean island while swimming from a friend's boat (A-2632.1). The host identifies the island as Sazan Island off Albania and says the friend was Nat Rothschild. A news report (A-2633.1) describes a fourth day of protests in Tirana against the Affinity Partners resort project, Prime Minister Edi Rama's statement that the investment will not stop, and an investigation opened by Albania's anti-corruption agency. A Tim Dillon clip (A-2634.1) criticizes the Trump family as "Tsarists."

In the final segments the host shows a US Weekly email (A-2635.1) giving her 24 hours to respond to a print story about Erika Kirk that quotes Tracy Martin and James Kaddis. She disputes Tracy Martin's claim that Charlie Kirk was scared to answer her calls and alleges that the byline is a non-existent journalist. She also comments on Ariana Grande's split from Ethan Slater. In the comments segment she criticizes Andrew Kolvet's association with Paramount Tactical and repeats her demand for a yes-or-no answer from Turning Point USA.

claims.label: Dana Loesch posted more than 23 tweets after saying she did not care about criticism
claims.claim: The host says Dana Loesch claimed on X that she did not care about people mocking her Women's Leadership Summit speech, but then authored more than 23 tweets responding to critics.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive Dana Loesch's X posts from June 9, 2026 and count her replies on the speech.
claims.transcript_snippet: She took to X to claim that and no big deal, I don't care. but then proceeded to author more than 23 tweets in response to people calling her out.

claims.label: Erika Kirk cut short her WLS speech after being called a "pedophile protector"
claims.claim: According to the host's sources, after someone called Erika Kirk a "pedophile protector" at the Women's Leadership Summit, she did not complete her full speech and shortened it.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the scheduled length and text of Erika Kirk's WLS 2026 speech with full event footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: Anyway, I want to let you guys know that after someone called Erika Kirk a pedophile protector. Erika actually did not complete the entirety of her speech.

claims.label: Erika Kirk left the Women's Leadership Summit without closing out the event
claims.claim: The host says she was told Erika Kirk then left the Women's Leadership Summit altogether and did not stay to close the event and thank organizers, as Charlie Kirk always did.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the WLS 2026 run of show and closing-session footage to see who closed the event.
claims.transcript_snippet: And beyond that, that she then ditched the um women's leadership summit event altogether. Not staying to close out the event. That's uh something that Charlie always did.

claims.label: Dana Loesch confirmed on her show that Erika Kirk did not stay the whole weekend
claims.claim: In a clip played by the host, Dana Loesch says Erika Kirk was scheduled to be at the summit for the whole weekend but was not there for all of it. The host says this confirms her scoop.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the full Dana Loesch show episode and the published WLS 2026 schedule for Erika Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: She wasn't there for the whole weekend. She was scheduled to be there for the whole weekend, but who would want to endure that?

claims.label: Antifa chased the host and Charlie Kirk out of a Philadelphia restaurant and threw an egg at Charlie
claims.claim: The host says Antifa once chased her and Charlie Kirk out of a restaurant in Philadelphia and threw an egg at Charlie, who smiled, laughed and waved at the camera.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate contemporaneous news coverage and video of the Philadelphia restaurant incident.
claims.transcript_snippet: don't forget Antifa notoriously chased me and Charlie out of a restaurant in Philadelphia once. They threw an egg at Charlie and he smiled and he laughed and he waved at the camera.

claims.label: Host alleges Erika Kirk invented a Secret Service threat to avoid an empty crowd with JD Vance
claims.claim: The host alleges that Erika Kirk did not want to face an empty crowd with JD Vance and instead made up a Secret Service threat requiring her to fly home, leaving the vice president to speak in her absence.
claims.investigative_direction: Request Secret Service threat-assessment records for the event and compare with TPUSA's public explanation for Erika Kirk's absence.
claims.transcript_snippet: That's why she did not want to face an empty crowd with JD Vance and she instead chose to make up a secret service proof threat which required her to fly home

claims.label: Erika Kirk attended the White House Correspondents' Dinner, which Charlie Kirk never attended
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk chose to attend the White House Correspondents' Dinner, an event her husband never attended, and was filmed saying she wanted to go home after the Secret Service shooting incident.
claims.investigative_direction: Check WHCD guest lists for prior years for Charlie Kirk's attendance.
claims.transcript_snippet: She then made a decision to attend a public function, the White House correspondents dinner, somewhere her husband never attended

claims.label: Greg Laurie is accused in court of trafficking people from Romania
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk partners on faith work with people credibly accused in court, as she says Greg Laurie is, of trafficking people from Romania.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the court filings in the Harvest Christian Fellowship Romanian lawsuits and check whether Greg Laurie is a named defendant.
claims.transcript_snippet: who are credibly accused one way or the other in the court of law as Greg Laurie is of trafficking people from Romania.

claims.label: Host alleges Erika Kirk was in Jeffrey Epstein's orbit at Next Model Management
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk was "hanging around Jeffrey Epstein's orbit of people over at Next Model Management in New York City" and says she would like to hear an explanation.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Erika Kirk's modeling-agency history and Next Model Management's documented links to Epstein associates.
claims.transcript_snippet: Maybe there's a reasonable explanation why she was hanging around Jeffrey Epstein's orbit of people over at Next Model Management in New York City.

claims.claim: The host alleges that Erika Kirk personally phoned priests, bishops and attendees, telling them not to attend the Catholics for Catholics prayer event the host held in March, where the host spoke.

claims.label: Host sent two further emails seeking an on-record yes or no
claims.claim: The host says she wrote to TPUSA twice more, on June 9 and the morning of June 10, asking for a written response from an identifiable executive on whether the video is authentic and in context. She says neither email has received a response.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the emails with headers and timestamps and any TPUSA reply.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, I have since written them twice by email, politely insisting upon a written response from an identifiable Turning Point USA executive.

claims.label: Blake Neff and Graham Allen do not work for Turning Point USA
claims.claim: The host says Blake Neff and Graham Allen do not work for Turning Point USA, and that TPUSA keeps sending out its "soldiers" instead of Erika Kirk, Andrew Kolvet or Justin Streiff clarifying the video.

claims.transcript_snippet: And to be clear, Blake Neff does not work for Turning Point USA. Graham Allen does not work for Turning Point USA.

claims.claim: The host says TPUSA withheld the full video to protect the donor. She names the donors who asked Charlie Kirk what would happen if he were not there as Julie Fields and Arthur Fields of North Carolina, and says this removes TPUSA's barrier to releasing the full video.

claims.investigative_direction: Obtain a sworn statement from the donor source and forensic analysis of the original video file.
claims.transcript_snippet: Um in fact, the donor who told me that it's doctorred and is willing to go very far on this claim that that that is doctorred uh said that they similarly thought the same thing.

claims.transcript_snippet: And Charlie never once said anything about Erika to them about his plans. He simply reiterated that the board would figure it out.

claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Kolvet-hosted segment with Graham Allen and compare with any FOIA production of the email.
